weeklyLearningAria.message: Weekly usage estimate is still learning

weeklyLearningTooltip.message: Weekly estimates may be inaccurate during the first week while Usage Bar learns your pattern.

otherHint.message: The model couldn't be determined for these messages. This can come from Claude Code and cowork.

errNoWorker.message: Unable to contact extension background worker

collecting.message: Collecting usage — your daily chart fills in as you chat on claude.ai.

setShowOverlayDesc.message: Display the usage bar overlay in the Claude chat composer.

setLanguageDesc.message: Language for the usage overlay and popup. Defaults to English.

setTourDesc.message: Walk through the extension features step by step.

setReviewDesc.message: Enjoying Claude Usage Bar? A rating helps others discover it and takes less than a minute. You can also request features or suggest other products you'd like to see right in your review.

setPrivacyDesc.message: View what Claude Usage Bar accesses, stores, and never sends to the developer.

setProjectDesc.message: Open the public Claude Usage Bar site with links to support and privacy information.

setShowBarDesc.message: Show the horizontal usage meter in the composer toolbar.

setBarShowsDesc.message: Which usage metric the bar fill represents.

setBarLabelDesc.message: Display the current percentage as text next to the bar.

setShowWheelDesc.message: Show the circular ring indicator next to the bar.

setWheelShowsDesc.message: Which usage metric the wheel fill represents.

setWheelLabelDesc.message: Display the current percentage as small text below the wheel.

setShowCacheTimerDesc.message: Show a countdown in the chat header for how long the prompt cache stays warm. Turn this off to hide it.

setLearnWeeklyDesc.message: Use local numeric samples to tune weekly estimates. Turn this off to keep weekly pacing on the fixed manual schedule.

setWeeklyEstimateDesc.message: Smart mode starts from about ten 5-hour windows per week, then learns your active Claude pattern from local numeric usage samples.

setWeeklyDisplayDesc.message: Active hours shows usable Claude time left. Days / time predicts the local day and time you will run out.

setManualDaysDesc.message: Used as the default schedule while smart weekly metrics are learning, or whenever manual mode is selected.

setManualHoursDesc.message: Used as the starting cap for weekly pacing before smart metrics have enough history.

setManualStartDesc.message: Local time used with manual days to place weekly usage into calendar time.

setLearnedPatternDesc.message: Stored locally in this browser. No prompts, responses, cookies, or raw Claude payloads are stored.

setShowPaceDesc.message: Show the pace estimate next to the usage bar. Accurate pace requires pattern learning — to opt out of pattern-based pacing, turn this off.

setPaceFormatDesc.message: What to show next to the 5-hour percentage: the percentage you'll be at when reset hits, the extra time you'll have past reset, or an estimate of how many messages you have left at the model you're using.
